t.en: We now define a matrix operation which in some ways plays the role of division. We cannot divide by a matrix, but we can multiply by the inverse of a matrix, which is almost as good.
t.zh: 下面定义一种矩阵运算，它在某种意义上起着除法的作用。我们不能“除以”一个矩阵，但可以乘以它的逆，这几乎一样好用。

t.en: Let $A$ and $B$ be $n\times n$-matrices. We say that $B$ is an **inverse** of $A$ if
t.zh: 设 $A$ 和 $B$ 是 $n\times n$ 矩阵。如果满足下式，则称 $B$ 是 $A$ 的**逆**（inverse）：

t.en: If this is the case, we also write $B=A^{-1}$. When a matrix has an inverse, it is called **invertible**.
t.zh: 满足上式时，我们也记 $B=A^{-1}$。有逆的矩阵称为**可逆**（invertible）矩阵。

title.en: Verifying the inverse of a matrix

t.en: Let $A=\left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{array}\right]$. Check that $B=\left[\begin{array}{rr} 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 \end{array}\right]$ is an inverse of $A$.
t.zh: 设 $A=\left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{array}\right]$。验证 $B=\left[\begin{array}{rr} 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 \end{array}\right]$ 是 $A$ 的逆。

t.en: This shows that $B$ is indeed an inverse of $A$.
t.zh: 这说明 $B$ 确实是 $A$ 的逆。

t.en: Unlike multiplication of scalars, it can happen that $A\neq 0$ but $A$ does not have an inverse. This is illustrated in the following example.
t.zh: 与数的乘法不同，可能出现 $A\neq 0$ 但 $A$ 没有逆的情形。下面的例子说明了这一点。

title.en: A non-zero matrix with no inverse

t.en: Let $A=\left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{array}\right]$. Show that $A$ is not invertible.

t.en: Can a matrix have more than one inverse? It turns out that this is not the case: the following theorem shows that if $A$ has an inverse, then the inverse is unique. We can therefore speak of “the” inverse, rather than just “an” inverse, of $A$.
t.zh: 一个矩阵能不能有不止一个逆？结果是不能：下面的定理说明，如果 $A$ 有逆，那么它的逆是唯一的。因此我们可以说 $A$ 的“那个”逆，而不只是“一个”逆。

t.en: Suppose $A$ is an $n\times n$-matrix such that both $B$ and $C$ are inverses of $A$. Then $B=C$.
t.zh: 设 $A$ 是 $n\times n$ 矩阵，且 $B$ 和 $C$ 都是 $A$ 的逆。则 $B=C$。
